title: Google reveals 2026 hardware lineup: Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5, and Pixel Tag
summary: The new phones are joined by an updated Pixel Watch 5 with much the same story, as well as Google’s first in-house tracker device, the Pixel Tag. The Pixel 11 and the Pixel 11 Pro Fold have a new primary sensor.
